title: Juvenile Liberty club and Manuel Perez
summary: Williams describes parading with the Young Veterans and the Juveniles of Liberty, and recalls trumpeter Manuel Perez.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: You understand? I see. There was so much to do with the second line and on, and then we used to parade just like the, like the veteran. And I was a member of the young veteran. They had the old veteran and the young veteran, juvenile. And we got the juveniles of Liberty. They used to parade. Well Manuel got the best portion of that was Manuel Perez. He was a hell-fired man. He was an elder trumpet man. He looked like the little Dago. So he played plenty of horn.
At this block, the next block, he dies right there and he dies.
His nephew and them live across the street over there.
